summary: Scoped a from-scratch, 3D-printed LeKiwi build walkthrough (SO-ARM101 arm + holonomic wheeled base), organized into build phases each explicitly chapter-mapped to Modern Robotics: Mechanics, Planning, and Control. Covers print-vs-buy component split, printer requirements, phase-by-phase assembly, and software/firmware setup (calibration, LeRobot/HuggingFace stack) as a mapped phase. Builds on and cites forward from the completed prior task 20260818-modern-robotics-textbook-projects (textbook structure, LeKiwi buildability, BOM/cost range) rather than re-deriving those facts; scoped as a new standalone task with its own directory and full pipeline run.
